note: METHOD: one background script queried all 117 composers: MusicBrainz (artist search, then the works with linked recordings), Deezer (album and artist search on the name) and Apple's composerTerm song search (all 117, not only the composers with nothing elsewhere), plus IMSLP's composer pages and the wikitext of all 570 candidate pages (publisher, first performance, performers). Hits were opened through Deezer and Apple track lists, Wikipedia, MusicWeb International and 14 web searches; about 80 tool calls. One MusicBrainz lookup (Giannotti) failed and was repeated. KEPT (17): Grego's Talassocrazia (Martinu Quartet on Urbania, 2003, a label that may be the composer's own); Ferrante's Trine and Un gesto appena (Videoradio-RAI Trade albums, 2011) and L'incertezza (Zecchini Editore, recording on IMSLP); Hedges's Piano Trio Op. 69, Flute Trio No. 1 and Refractions 1 (premieres by the Leonardo Trio and the Allegri Quartet, BBC Radio 3 broadcasts, per MusicWeb International; no commercial disc); van Gulick's String Quartet No. 1 (Alauda Strijkkwartet, label P3M 2019, perhaps his own). Nine more rest only on recordings or performances hosted on IMSLP by named ensembles, none commercial, all at confidence low (as are L'incertezza and the van Gulick quartet), and the owner can drop them: Fries Opp. 7, 9, 10, 22, 42 (Hibiki Quartet, Dionysos-Quartett; the pianist 'Gerhard Schluesslmayr' is the composer's civil name), Heeren's 6 Harmvolle Bagatellen (Petersen-Quartett, not identified), Ferrari's Camille (Carson Cooman) and Serenata 4 (Ligeti Quartet workshop video), Marshall Fine's Music in Homage (Luna Nova Music, Memphis). Levels are estimates from the scoring and idiom; no score was opened. EXCLUSIONS: 85 composers are proposed in exclude_composers (IMSLP self-uploads; no recording of any chamber work, no publisher and no professional performance found in MusicBrainz, Deezer, Apple or the IMSLP pages). 24 composers whose pages all fail the floor are not proposed because some profile exists (Wikipedia article, established publisher, recordings of other works, or professional performances claimed on IMSLP): their pages are skipped as not performed or recorded. Claims on IMSLP that I could not verify and did not accept: Gotham (Fitzwilliam String Quartet, 2019), Friedl (Mivos Quartet), Hovhannisyan (dedication to the Petersen Quartet, YouTube premiere recordings), Igoa (Grupo Cosmos 21), Guestrin (Trio del Sur), Harrington (APEIM String Quartet, 2006; his Deezer album 'Chamber Music' is self-released). NOT ENTERED: Ferrante's Axios String Quartet disc (Videoradio-RAI Trade, 2012, Deezer 3490471, ten string-quartet pieces whose IMSLP pages were not among the candidates); the other tracks of Grego's disc (Francesca da Rimini, Quanti siete qui dentro?, Un mar deserto); Höricht's Orfeo (String Quartet) with the Ponticulus Quartett (own label). Namesake noise is heavy for Green, Harding, Hamilton, Graham, Giles and Gomez, so 'none found' is weak for them. The throttled fetcher made the run slow (about 80 minutes).
